dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: #One day, I shall certainly create a great Glaze Lily garden in this place! Hmm? Is something the matter, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Oh, so you're just here to watch? Well then, feel free! My grand gardening campaign continues!

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: That may be so, yet in caring for these Qingxin my gardening prowess shall increase.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wuchou
dialogues.text: Once I have honed my skills enough, I shall transplant a batch of Glaze Lilies over!
